narr: Abundant moisture(PWAT 1.8) and moderate to high instability (MLCAPE 1000-2000 J/KG) led to the development of diurnally induced isolated thunderstorm activity, mainly across portions of southwestern Arizona. A strong thunderstorm developed near the Quartzsite area during the late afternoon, resulting in flash flooding in areas adjacent to Tyson Wash.
ev: Tyson Street, West Quail Trail Street and East Kuhen Street were all closed due to overflowing water from Tyson Wash. No damages or injuries were reported.
lsr: TYSON STREET, W QUAIL TRAIL STREET AND E KUHEN STREET WERE ALL CLOSED DUE TO OVERFLOWING WATER FROM TYSON WASH.
